source.title: Belfast Telegraph, 18 May 1967, p. 9 ("Larne")
source.publisher: Belfast Telegraph (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: read on the page image (BT 18 May 1967 p. 9, Larne paragraph): Gardenmore Ward, Bertha Jackson (Ind.) 784, Robert S. Thompson (Lab.) 492; not elected John Ledgers (Lab.) 421; new member Mrs. Jackson. The returning officer's notice of 1964 (Larne Times, 28 May 1964, p. 3) spells the sitting councillor LETTERS, John, 51 Green Drive.

note: Borough election, polled 17 May 1967; seats were contested in three of the five wards only, Townspark, Gardenmore and Inver (Belfast Telegraph, 18 May 1967, p. 9). Mrs. Jackson, a new member, headed the poll; the outgoing Labour member Mr. Thompson held the second seat and Councillor John Letters was defeated.
correctionNote: Corrected from the page image of the Belfast Telegraph, 18 May 1967, p. 9 (council-audit, Nov 2026): Bertha Jackson, as printed, was entered as 'Berthal' from the OCR; the defeated Labour councillor is printed 'John Ledgers' but is the sitting member John Letters of the 1964 returning officer's notice (Larne Times, 28 May 1964, p. 3), so the name is Letters and the printed form is kept in Name_As_Printed.
